claim_verdicts.suggested_text: `factory` marks a constructor that runs its own code and returns the object; here it reads the `Map` and calls the ordinary `Product(...)` constructor.

issues.text: The factory gloss is vaguer than any source: "in its own way" suggests an ordinary constructor could not build from a Map, which the lesson does not justify. Pinned docs only call fromJson a factory constructor that creates an object from JSON.
issues.quote: `factory` marks a constructor that builds its object in its own way, here from a `Map`.
issues.fix: Replace with: "`factory` marks a constructor that runs its own code and returns the object; here it reads the `Map` and calls the ordinary `Product(...)` constructor." Keep claim 11 as is.
